rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a male sheep.

example.english: That ram at the zoo is very bad-tempered.
example.traditional: 動物園入面嗰隻公羊好有脾氣。
example.jyutping: dung6 mat6 jyun4 jap6 min6 go2 zek3 gung1 joeng4 hou2 jau5 pei4 hei3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the heavy object used to smash through a door.

example.english: In ancient times, soldiers used a battering ram to smash through the city gate.
example.traditional: 古代士兵會用撞門槌撞穿城門。
example.jyutping: gu2 doi6 si6 bing1 wui5 jung6 zong6 mun4 ceoi4 zong6 cyun1 sing4 mun4
